contexts.text: When the spiritual Angels utter A there is something of E, or AE, in it... whereas the words of the celestial Angels have an affinity with A, O, and U, and therefore [their speech] falls into such words as contain these vowels. For this reason, when a man is speaking with the latter, he is diverted from words that contain E, and I, to those which contain A, O, and U. SE 5620.
(In the Most-Ancient Heaven, not that of the modern celestials) instead of A, they say AO, diphthong.
